bias.en: Rebound · reclaimed the 10 and 100-day, at the 5 and 30-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 10 日和 100 日均线，触及 5 日和 30 日均线

read.en: AMD rose 5.3% on Nov 18 to $530.14, trading $495.20–532.17. It is above the 10-day ($508.7), 100-day ($526.9) and 200-day ($427.2), all rising, and just below the 5-day ($531.4) and 30-day ($533.6, falling). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening again; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($451.40), and RSI is 50.3.
read.zh: AMD 11月18日上涨 5.3%，收于 $530.14，盘中区间 $495.20–532.17。股价位于 10 日（$508.7）、100 日（$526.9）和 200 日均线（$427.2）上方，三者均在上行，并略低于 5 日（$531.4）和 30 日均线（$533.6，下行）。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图再度放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$451.40），RSI 为 50.3。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $504.6–511.9 and $520–531 resistances (10-day, 100-day), now support. Resistance is $531.4–533.6 (5 and 30-day, Nov 18 high), then $552.9 (Nov 11 close) and $567.7–571.1 (Nov 11 and 13 highs). Support is $520–527, then $501.3–508.7 (10-day, Oct 22 and Nov 16 lows) and $480.5–495.2. A close above $533.6 would target $553; below $520, $502–509.

s.en: Nov 17 low $480.50; Nov 4 close $488.78; Nov 18 low $495.20
